pool.text: Arusha was conquered by the Germans after the murder of two missionaries.
The Germans established a permanent presence when a military fort was built.
The British took Arusha from the Germans during World War I.
The extension of the railroad greatly increased commerce in the area.
The Great Depression squelched commerce and Arusha had fewer than residents.
A state of emergency was declared in response to the Mau Mau Uprising.
Official documents ceding independence to Tanganyika were signed at Arusha.
Arusha was the setting for the film Hatari starring John Wayne.
The Arusha Declaration was signed in the city of Arusha.
A public museum was opened displaying important assets to the scientific community.
The Arusha Accords were signed by representatives of competing factions.
The UN Security Council decided that Arusha should host the tribunal.
The Arusha Peace and Reconciliation Agreement for Burundi was signed.
Arusha was granted city status with it becoming official later.
A quarry located in Arusha collapsed and killed fourteen miners.
The Arusha Agreement created a framework for the reunification of the party.
